source: Paper › Master - Product (01M3M69CTR7XJ8F5KP1405RC6F), the TPL · … · Desktop 2056×1160 artboards, exported at 2x as sRGB WebP. Crops are in screen px (2056×1160).

schedule.about: The day schedule: the patient panel on the left and four columns (rooms, hygiene) of colour-coded appointments.

day.about: the day grid without the patient panel

patient-panel.about: the patient summary: balance, quick links, next appointment, tasks

schedule-new-patient.about: The schedule with a new patient's appointment selected.

schedule-popovers.about: The schedule with the production goals bar, an appointment's details, the status menu and a new-patient slot open.

goals.about: net production, goal, % to goal, completed, scheduled

appointment-details.about: an appointment's details: patient, time, provider, notes, forms

status-menu.about: the appointment status menu (unconfirmed to checkout)

new-patients-slot.about: a block reserved for new patients

charting.about: Clinical charting: the odontogram, the add-to-chart procedures and the perio exams list.

add-to-chart.about: adding a treatment: procedure categories and codes

charting-history.about: Charting with the treatment history table (procedures, conditions, status, provider).

charting-perio.about: The perio chart being filled in, with plaque, calculus, bleeding and suppuration shortcuts.

perio-chart.about: the perio chart grid, upper and lower arches

messaging.about: Patient messaging: the inbox and a text conversation with reminders sent by Archy (the thread holds a photo the patient sent, drawn as a blue placeholder).

reminders.about: the top of the thread: an appointment reminder sent by Archy
